rules.selection: Within each gold left/right x historical Full correct/wrong stratum, sort abs(Full Margin),qid; split into four contiguous rank bins (numpy.array_split). In each bin prefer a geometry-valid same-length same-P-1-token real pair, then any valid pair, then nearest bin median abs Margin, then qid. One image per bin. No current model outcome used.
rules.pair: Original frozen CVPR-author GQA ChooseRel CSV rows only; same image, distinct question and subject object2 ID, positive visible target ROIs with distinct patch sets. Choose minimum prompt-length difference, then qid. No rewritten questions, labels, boxes, padding or resampling.
rules.source: Fixed CVPR 2025 author CSV at c9a1111dac4baa175f67716fab473789320187c0, with original GQA IDs/answers/object boxes; not independently verified against original Stanford annotation JSON. Official download page connection timed out during preparation.
rules.score: Original full conditional candidate sequence logP, no EOS; fixed left/right each verified one token; original teacher-forced candidate inputs and prediction P-1, margin>0 correct, tie wrong. A is prompt-only Native Full, B uses original candidate-prefill protocol; do not compare them bitwise across lengths.
rules.spatial: Per real query and head normalize visual probabilities, then average queries within Question, then heads. P-1 is one query. JS is sqrt(Jensen-Shannon divergence), natural log, no pseudocount; cosine compares pooled spatial maps. Raw visual Mass is separately head/query averaged.
rules.hidden: B: compare each token to its own Full then average Question token cosine distances and change norms. A: mean-pool real Question token hidden states separately per question, then compare pooled vectors; never align different questions by absolute token index. P-1 is a single vector. Capture decoder block outputs (after residual/MLP).
rules.l0_check: For same image/P-1 token/absolute position matched pairs require exact L0 P-1 input, visual inputs and visual QK scores; compare visual-only FP32 softmax exactly. Raw FP16 attention conditional maps can differ through denominator-dependent rounding. Do not call raw Mass differences spatial selectivity.
rules.audit: Reuse original additive mask clone / -inf knockout. Only L0/L1 targets differ; local same-input Native Attention replay checks non-target query rows bitwise. Later layer masks, not their attention values after changed hidden inputs, must remain native. No requirement that unblocked probabilities within a masked query stay equal.
rules.interpretation: Descriptive stratified mechanism pilot, not unbiased population estimate or statistical significance. No layer scan, training, decode, cache, physical exit, additional mask or dataset.
